title: View
description: A view: a small named file that decides how a model is processed (which rule profile, which layout switches, which derivations). It lives outside the model. Every view passes this gate (scripts/shared/view.js) before anything reads it; unknown keys are refused at every level.

ruleProfile.description: A rule profile NAME (resolved inside rules/), never a path.

lanes.description: Lanes formed from the assignments of a format 2.x model: per performer (role), per unit of the performer (unit), per system of the task (system) or none; or the object form { by: "role" | "unit", … }. For units, `level` counts the organigram (partOf) from the top, 1 = units without partOf, and `nested` draws sub-units as lanes inside their parent. For both, `automatic: "lane"` puts every automatic task without performer into a placeholder lane of its own (`automaticName`, default "(automatisch)"); the system view takes the string form only. Absent: a 1.x model keeps its own lanes, a 2.x model gets role lanes. On a 1.x model a view with lanes is refused.

automatic.description: Where an automatic task without performer goes: "neighbour" (default) with its neighbour by the inheritance rule (H03), "lane" into a placeholder lane of its own (H19). Not in the system view.

automaticName.description: The name of that lane in this view; default from scripts/config.json laneFormation.automaticName, "(automatisch)". Only with automatic "lane".
